subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.-----PRI.INFO.
description: Diagram opening R(AS)CM(II)-45 — the section on the 'every man for himself' phenomenon among creative musicians in America vs. the unification possible in Europe. The prose immediately below the diagram (the section's argument) identifies what the crossing diagrams: 'the present situation concerning creative music in America has to do with isolated individuals — some of whom are functioning, and most not. The success of real transformation implies that somehow this situation is corrected on some level.' The crossing diagrams the structural ground of the isolation: ALT-FT (alternative functionalism — the form's actual working) is crossed with PRI-INFO (principle information — the form's structured presentation as principle). ALT-FT sits at the upper-right with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs down-left to PRI-INFO. Three lines leave the main line: one runs left to PER-TRS (perceived transition), with ACT (activism) rising from it; one runs right to (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation), with a vertical dropping from it to AF-DY (affinity dynamics), AFI (affinity insight) branching from AF-DY's line, and PART (participation) branching in turn from AFI; and one runs right to ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics), with SF-RZ (self-realization) dropping from it.
